function AuraSkin(arg1)
    local ReplicatedStorage17 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild('Modules')
    local Net2 = ReplicatedStorage17:WaitForChild('Net')
    local unidentifiedvar2 = Net2:WaitForChild('RF/FruitCustomizerRF')
    local invokeresult = unidentifiedvar2:InvokeServer({
            StorageName = arg1,
            Type = 'AuraSkin',
            Context = 'Equip'
        })
end

end
